001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.format;
002
003import java.time.Instant;
004import java.time.ZoneId;
005import java.time.ZoneOffset;
006import java.util.Locale;
007import java.util.function.Function;
008
009import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
010
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.ServiceRegistry;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator;
016
017/**
018 * Pattern Config needed for pattern keywords that is generally platform specific. Through
019 * property configuration there can only be one pattern config but through programmatic
020 * configuration there is no limit by creating custom {@link PatternCompiler}.
021 * <p>
022 * This class is also a configurator for easy programmatic registration with
023 * {@link LogConfig.Builder#configurator(Configurator)}.
024 *
025 * @see PatternCompiler
026 *
027 */
028public sealed interface PatternConfig extends Configurator {
029
030        /**
031         * Formatter properties prefix
032         */
033        public static final String PATTERN_CONFIG_PREFIX = LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "pattern.config.{name}.";
034
035        /**
036         * Key Values that can be retrieved by various patterns.
037         */
038        public static final String PATTERN_PROPERY_PREFIX = LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "pattern.property.";
039
040        /**
041         * Default zoneId if not specified.
042         * @return zone id.
043         */
044        public ZoneId zoneId();
045
046        /**
047         * Line separator for %n by default uses {@link System#lineSeparator()}.
048         * @return line separator.
049         */
050        public String lineSeparator();
051
052        /**
053         * Whether or not print escape outputs. If true than the color patterns will not
054         * decorate.
055         * @return false if ANSI escape sequences can be outputted.
056         */
057        public boolean ansiDisabled();
058
059        /**
060         * Key Value function for ad-hoc property replacements and lookup in various patterns.
061         * @return function.
062         * @see #PATTERN_PROPERY_PREFIX
063         */
064        @SuppressWarnings("exports")
065        public Function<String, @Nullable String> propertyFunction();
066
067        /**
068         * The baseline instant used by <code>%r</code>/<code>%relative</code> to compute
069         * elapsed milliseconds. Captured once (e.g. when this config is built) rather than
070         * recomputed, the same way logback's <code>RelativeTimeConverter</code> captures its
071         * start time once when constructed.
072         * @return start time.
073         */
074        public Instant startTime();
075
076        /**
077         * The first value returned by <code>%lsn</code>. Defaults to <code>0</code>.
078         * @return sequence number start.
079         */
080        public long sequenceNumberStart();
081
082        /**
083         * Whether keywords that can cache their output (currently just
084         * <code>%logger{N}</code> via its abbreviator) actually do so. Defaults to
085         * {@link CacheType#BASIC}.
086         * @return cache type.
087         */
088        public CacheType abbreviatorCache();
089
090        /**
091         * Whether a keyword's own internal caching (currently just <code>%logger{N}</code>'s
092         * abbreviator) is used. {@link #BASIC} is the only real strategy implemented today -
093         * kept as an enum rather than a boolean so a possible future global cache toggle (the
094         * same idea already used for logger name caching and level resolvers) can reuse it
095         * without a breaking property-format change.
096         */
097        public enum CacheType {
098
099                /**
100                 * No caching - every call recomputes.
101                 */
102                DISABLED,
103                /**
104                 * The default cache.
105                 */
106                BASIC;
107
108                static CacheType parse(String value) {
109                        String v = value.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
110                        return switch (v) {
111                                case "TRUE", "DEFAULT" -> BASIC;
112                                case "FALSE" -> DISABLED;
113                                default -> LogProperty.enumValue(CacheType.class, value, "true", "default", "false");
114                        };
115                }
116
117        }
118
119        /**
120         * Creates a builder to create formatter config.
121         * @return builder.
122         * @apiNote {@link PatternConfig} implements {@link Configurator} so it can be
123         * registered at config time easily.
124         */
125        public static PatternConfigBuilder builder() {
126                return builder(LogProperties.DEFAULT_NAME);
127        }
128
129        /**
130         * Creates a builder to create formatter config.
131         * @param name for property resolution: {@value #PATTERN_CONFIG_PREFIX}.
132         * @return builder.
133         * @apiNote {@link PatternConfig} implements {@link Configurator} so it can be
134         * registered at config time easily.
135         */
136        public static PatternConfigBuilder builder(String name) {
137                return new PatternConfigBuilder(name);
138        }
139
140        /**
141         * Copies the config to builder.
142         * @param builder to receive properties.
143         * @param config to copy from.
144         * @return builder passed in.
145         */
146        public static PatternConfigBuilder copy(PatternConfigBuilder builder, PatternConfig config) {
147                builder.ansiDisabled(config.ansiDisabled());
148                builder.lineSeparator(config.lineSeparator());
149                builder.zoneId(config.zoneId());
150                builder.propertyFunction(config.propertyFunction());
151                builder.startTime(config.startTime());
152                builder.sequenceNumberStart(config.sequenceNumberStart());
153                builder.abbreviatorCache(config.abbreviatorCache());
154                return builder;
155        }
156
157        /**
158         * Default config.
159         * @return default config.
160         */
161        public static PatternConfig of() {
162                return StandardFormatterConfig.DEFAULT_FORMATTER_CONFIG;
163        }
164
165        /**
166         * Platform independent formatter config that will not change across timezones or
167         * platforms. <strong>The zoneId is UTC, line separator is LF, and ansi is
168         * disabled.</strong>
169         * @return config.
170         */
171        public static PatternConfig ofUniversal() {
172                return StandardFormatterConfig.UNIVERSAL_FORMATTER_CONFIG;
173        }
174
175        /**
176         * Creates a property function.
177         * @param properties log properties.
178         * @param prefix prefix keys before asking LogProperties.
179         * @return function.
180         */
181        @SuppressWarnings("exports")
182        public static Function<String, @Nullable String> propertyFunction(LogProperties properties, String prefix) {
183                record LogPropertiesPatternKeyValues(String prefix,
184                                LogProperties properties) implements Function<String, @Nullable String> {
185
186                        @Override
187                        public @Nullable String apply(String t) {
188                                String key = LogProperties.concatKey(prefix, t);
189                                return properties.valueOrNull(key);
190                        }
191
192                }
193                return new LogPropertiesPatternKeyValues(prefix, properties);
194        }
195
196        @Override
197        default boolean configure(LogConfig config, Pass pass) {
198                config.serviceRegistry().put(PatternConfig.class, ServiceRegistry.DEFAULT_SERVICE_NAME, this);
199                return true;
200        }
201
202}
203
204non-sealed interface DefaultFormatterConfig extends PatternConfig {
205
206        /**
207         * Default zoneId if not specified. If not overridden the system default will be used.
208         * @return zone id.
209         */
210        @Override
211        default ZoneId zoneId() {
212                return ZoneId.systemDefault();
213        }
214
215        /**
216         * Line separator for %n by default uses {@link System#lineSeparator()}.
217         * @return line separator.
218         */
219        @Override
220        default String lineSeparator() {
221                return System.lineSeparator();
222        }
223
224        /**
225         * Whether or not print escape outputs. If true than the color patterns will not
226         * decorate.
227         * @return false if ANSI escape sequences can be outputted.
228         */
229        @Override
230        default boolean ansiDisabled() {
231                return false;
232        }
233
234        @Override
235        default Function<String, @Nullable String> propertyFunction() {
236                return StandardPropertyFunction.INSTANCE;
237        }
238
239        /**
240         * Captured once when this interface is first loaded so all default configs share a
241         * single start time approximating application/logging startup.
242         */
243        @SuppressWarnings("TimeInStaticInitializer")
244        Instant DEFAULT_START_TIME = Instant.now();
245
246        @Override
247        default Instant startTime() {
248                return DEFAULT_START_TIME;
249        }
250
251        @Override
252        default long sequenceNumberStart() {
253                return 0L;
254        }
255
256        @Override
257        default CacheType abbreviatorCache() {
258                return CacheType.BASIC;
259        }
260
261        enum StandardPropertyFunction implements Function<String, @Nullable String> {
262
263                INSTANCE;
264
265                @Override
266                public @Nullable String apply(String t) {
267                        return null;
268                }
269
270        }
271
272}
273
274enum StandardFormatterConfig implements DefaultFormatterConfig {
275
276        DEFAULT_FORMATTER_CONFIG(), //
277        UNIVERSAL_FORMATTER_CONFIG {
278                @Override
279                public String lineSeparator() {
280                        return "\n";
281                }
282
283                @Override
284                public ZoneId zoneId() {
285                        return ZoneId.from(ZoneOffset.UTC);
286                }
287
288                @Override
289                public boolean ansiDisabled() {
290                        return true;
291                }
292
293                @Override
294                public Instant startTime() {
295                        return Instant.EPOCH;
296                }
297        };
298
299}
300
301record SimpleFormatterConfig(ZoneId zoneId, String lineSeparator, boolean ansiDisabled,
302                Function<String, @Nullable String> propertyFunction, Instant startTime, long sequenceNumberStart,
303                PatternConfig.CacheType abbreviatorCache) implements PatternConfig {
304
305}
